text: Vince Sferrazza, Director, Operations and Maintenance; and Jennifer Niece, Manager, Strategic Policy and Initiatives, will provide an update on the Major Snow Event Response Plan as a result of the major snow event in January 2022. Staff will present an update on past engagement, key definitions, the updates that have been made since the January 2022 event, and current ongoing work to address additional improvements to the City’s operations. Next steps and reporting timelines will be presented.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
